title: QA Finding
description: One reported defect. A finding with no evidence and no oracle is not a bug - it is discarded by tooling before a human ever sees it.

id.description: Stable hash of axis + route + locator + title.

tier.description: Set by triage, never by the finding agent. CONFIRMED requires: artifacts present + oracle cited + reproduced 3/3 cold by a different agent + negative control passed.

tierReason.description: Why triage assigned this tier. Required for anything below CONFIRMED.

oracle.description: What makes this WRONG rather than merely surprising. No citation caps severity at QUESTION.

type.description: Ranked most to least authoritative. 'none' means the agent only found it suspicious.

citation.description: file:line, i18n key, ticket id, or the exact on-screen text relied on.

quote.description: The source text itself, so a human can judge without opening anything.

locator.description: Playwright locator that anchors the failure.

steps.description: Human-readable repro. Must match what the spec file actually does.

evidence.description: Artifact-or-it-did-not-happen. Missing specFile or trace => auto-DISCARDED.

specFile.description: Re-runnable Playwright spec, relative to the run dir.

determinism.description: 3/3 cold failures = bug. 1-2/3 = flake, filed separately and never as a bug.

negativeControl.description: Same spec against the parent commit / the expected path. Failing there too means the SPEC is wrong, not the app.

verifiedBy.description: Agent id that reproduced it cold - must differ from the finder.

tracker.description: Populated only after a human approves the draft. Never auto-created.
